video.title: AI欧腐《被Alpha背叛后，我拿下他弟弟/My Alpha's Betrayal：I Took His Brother》
video.desc:
After discovering her husband Elian’s affair, Omega Irving seeks revenge by spending one night with his younger brother Kel. What begins as a deal soon becomes real love. Defying social expectations, they choose each other and build a happy family together.
发现丈夫 Elian 出轨后，Omega Irving 为了报复，与他的弟弟 Kel 共度了一夜。起初只是一场交易，却很快变成了真爱。两人不顾世俗眼光，坚定地选择了彼此，共同组建了幸福的家庭。
